notebook.exclusion_patch:
_EXCLUDED = {r['file_sha'] for r in __import__('csv').DictReader(open(ROOT / 'results/skillguard_runs/next1000/exclusions/excluded_file_shas.csv', encoding='utf-8'))}  # draw_sample.py
_eligible = ~frame['stratum'].astype(str).str.startswith('excluded')
frame.loc[_eligible & frame['file_sha'].isin(_EXCLUDED), 'stratum'] = 'excluded: previously used in SkillGuard experiments'  # draw_sample.py

exclusion_label: excluded: previously used in SkillGuard experiments

exclusions_summary.note: Unresolved MalSkills entries cannot be excluded without skill_mapping.csv; at most this many skills of the new sample could overlap the MalSkills samples.

frame_change: Representatives previously used in SkillGuard/Cisco/MalSkills experiments were removed from the eligible frame before drawing; population_N and design weights refer to the reduced frame. Two MalSkills entries could not be mapped to a DB identity and therefore could not be excluded (exclusions/unresolved.csv).
